senses.definition: An electronic device for detecting sound, vibration, etc., such as one fitted to an electric guitar or record player.

subsenses.definition: In a record player, an electromagnetic component that converts the needle vibrations into an electrical signal.
Electromagnetic coil receiver of metal string oscillations.
The reception of sound, etc. by such a device.
examples: This microphone has very weak pickup.

senses.definition: (usually attributive) Impromptu or ad hoc, especially of sports games and teams made up of randomly selected players.

senses.definition: An instance of approaching someone and engaging in romantic flirtation and courting with the intent to pursue romance, a date, or a sexual encounter.
examples: Hey, thanks for the drink, but if this is a pickup, I'm not interested.

senses.definition: A person successfully approached in this manner for romance or sex.
